summary: Iteration 9: Verified Microsoft OAuth client_secret rotation fix. Direct API call to POST /api/auth/microsoft/callback with valid state + fake code returned 400 with 'invalid_grant' / AADSTS9002313 (NOT AADSTS7000215 / invalid_client), confirming new MS_CLIENT_SECRET is accepted by Microsoft. Full regression: 113/113 backend tests passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MS OAuth callback endpoint working correctly with new client secret. Live evidence: response body contains "error": "invalid_grant" and AADSTS9002313, no AADSTS7000215. All 113 pytest cases pass in ~57s.
rca of the issue: Previous client secret expired/rotated causing AADSTS7000215. Fixed by updating MS_CLIENT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env with new value and restarting backend supervisor. Verified end-to-end via live callback against login.microsoftonline.com.
